sourceFinding.finding: Opaque gray backing remains visible around feather tips and trailing edges, exposing the card or sheet silhouette instead of the feather silhouette.
sourceFinding.reason: The visible sheet perimeter destroys feather separation, creates a toy-like plate edge and remains obvious in bright, neutral and backlit views.

zones.meaning: Pixels outside the actual feather silhouette must be fully transparent.
Outer barbs and worn edge fibers may be partially transparent with irregular, directional breakup.
Most of the feather vane remains opaque; the complete feather must not become uniformly translucent.
The central shaft and structurally dense base remain opaque.

correctionModel.requiredTechnique: hybrid opaque core plus soft fringe

runtimeCalibration.sourceViewer: Sketchfab Viewer API Opacity material channel
operations: enable and update the Opacity channel through setMaterial
compare original and calibrated viewers on bright, sky-blue and warm-gray backgrounds
export mask PNG and calibration JSON
runtimeCalibration.boundary: Runtime calibration is evidence and tuning only; it does not rewrite the licensed source asset.

opaqueCore.reason: Stable depth, stable ordering and lower transparent-overdraw cost.

softFringe.preferredAlphaMode: BLEND, dithered blend or alpha-to-coverage on a narrow fringe only
softFringe.reason: Preserve fine barb softness without making the complete vane transparent.

textureRules: Use RGBA texture data with a real alpha channel.
Dilate feather RGB colors beneath transparent pixels to prevent dark or gray halos after filtering and mipmapping.
Keep fully transparent voids outside the silhouette; do not leave gray backing pixels.
Use region-aware irregular fringe breakup rather than a uniform blurred outline.
Preserve distinct primary, secondary and covert silhouettes; do not reuse one identical mask everywhere.
Verify both faces where cards are visible; backface handling must not create disappearing feathers.
Author alpha-aware mip levels so distant feathers do not thicken, vanish or become rectangular.

qualityGates.title: no card perimeter
qualityGates.pass: No rectangular, triangular or gray sheet perimeter remains visible around feather tips or trailing edges.

qualityGates.title: opaque vane core
qualityGates.pass: The main vane remains visually solid; transparency is confined to voids and the narrow barb fringe.

qualityGates.title: soft directional fringe
qualityGates.pass: The fringe is semi-transparent, irregular and aligned with barb direction rather than a uniform blur.

qualityGates.title: no dark halo
qualityGates.pass: No black, gray or bright outline appears under bilinear filtering, mipmapping, bright background or rim light.

qualityGates.title: motion stability
qualityGates.pass: No sorting pop, flicker, swimming mask, card intersection or edge inversion appears through eight normalized wing phases.

qualityGates.title: mobile overdraw evidence
qualityGates.pass: Transparent area is tightly cropped and measured; broad full-wing alpha sheets are rejected.

qualityGates.title: regional variation
qualityGates.pass: Primary, secondary, covert and tail masks differ in taper, wear and fringe width without random noise.
